correctness.rationale: The reviewed full RESULT reconstructs the no-delay disease-free planar system and rare-infection transverse equation. At d0=(1+theta)/2, Jacobian trace crosses zero with positive determinant; canonical Hopf derivatives cancel to l1=-f0/4<0 and leading Var(x)=2d0 epsilon. Integrating z-dot/z over each periodic orbit yields mean(x)=d exactly. Integrating x-dot/x and expanding to second order with the sinusoidal covariance yields mean(z)-z*(d)=C epsilon+o(epsilon), C=2d0/K*(h*f_zz*z0/(2d0*K)-f0). For theta=1/5, alpha=26/3125 and eta=92/225 or 1/100, independently evaluated exact rational C values -72008352/212226125 and +1645176/6555125. The infection Floquet exponent difference is -3C epsilon/2, and positive mu can be chosen between near-critical thresholds. This is local sufficiency, not global invasion persistence. Independently rebuilt symbolic fractions; inspected check code, did not rely on VERIFY_OK alone.

value.rationale: The signed cycle-versus-equilibrium invasion discrepancy matters for interpreting disease invasion at a Hopf-unstable ecological coexistence point. Two exact same-model positive-parameter witnesses reverse the direction while the susceptible mean is conserved; this is not a mere numerical example or general statement that Floquet averaging is possible.
